reason: A DSH shell provider that executes bash commands while preserving raw output bytes and automatically decoding mixed or non-UTF-8 encodings, primarily to prevent Chinese-character garbling in Windows and WSL environments.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供支持原始字节采集和自动编码识别的 bash 执行器，减少 Windows 与 WSL 环境中的中文输出乱码。
summaries.en: Provides DSH with a bash executor that collects raw output bytes and detects common encodings to reduce garbled text in Windows and WSL environments.

capabilities: Collects raw stdout and stderr bytes
Automatically detects and decodes UTF-16LE, UTF-8, GBK, and related encodings
Manages command timeouts, stdin, output limits, and background process lifecycles
